'''Robert Koper''' (also published as '''Rob Koper''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 28th at [[2001 Georgia State Championship]] on 5 May 2001, according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2248">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-draw], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-wal-mart-stickers-and-the-anti-drawd2248/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Rob Koper (DeckTech handle '''Corum''') he posted a [[Dark]] [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.<ref name="dt-17033">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17033 Your Retrieval Can Decieve You], DeckTech (Rob "Corum" Koper, 26 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17033/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17033/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
